checkRuns.command:
sed -i 's/^export function generateStaticParams/export const dynamicParams = false;\n\nexport function generateStaticParams/' app/books/\[slug\]/page.tsx
bun run build 2>&1 | grep -i -B2 -A8 'error' | head -20
PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
for p in /books/nope /books/dracula; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4711$p) $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/o)"; done
pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa next

sed -i '/cacheComponents\|partialPrefetching/d' next.config.ts
bun run check 2>&1 | tail -3; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -12
PORT=4711 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4711 NODE_ENV=production bun run start >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &
sleep 4
for p in /books/nope /books/dracula /zzz; do echo "$p $(curl -s -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}' http://127.0.0.1:4711$p) $(grep -o '<title>[^<]*' /tmp/o)"; done
curl -s -X POST -d 'name=+Al+&email=x&message=short' http://127.0.0.1:4711/contact -o /tmp/o -w '%{http_code}\n'
pkill -f "next start"; pkill -f "next-server"; sleep 1; pgrep -fa next

docs.source: https://nextjs.org/docs/llms.txt and the Markdown of the pages it links
